How to use Mad Hatter

  1. Enter your design idea, then choose one hat or select All hats.
  2. Start with Blue to frame what needs attention. Do not start with Black.
  3. All Hats mode follows Blue → White → Green → Yellow → Black → Red → Blue. Use Next to move through the sequence.
  4. After two different hats, Review Mode unlocks. Refine your idea and run the review.
  5. Progress is kept only for the current browser session. Download the PDF before refreshing or closing the page if you want a personal copy.
  6. Download the personal PDF if you want your own copy.

Suggested full design sequence: Blue → White → Green → Yellow → Black → Red → Blue. This is a useful path, not a required order.
